The scanner shall be brand new, unused, genuine and current production. 2. Refurbished, reconditioned, used or discontinued equipment shall not be accepted. 3. The scanner shall be a standard OEM-manufactured product. 4. All required cables, power adapters, drivers, software and standard accessories shall be supplied. 5. The quoted price shall include the scanner, OCR software, scanning software, accessories, installation and commissioning wherever applicable. 6. The equipment shall comply with applicable GeM General Terms and Conditions and relevant Gover nment of India procurement requirements. 5. Documents to be Submitted with the Bid The bidder shall submit: 1. Technical compliance statement against each specification.

2. OEM product datasheet or official brochure of the offered scanner. 3. OEM authorization certificate, wherever required under applicable GeM bid conditions. 4. Details of the offered scanning and OCR software. 5. Declaration confirming that the offered equipment is new and unused. 6. Details of OEM warranty and service support. 7. Official OEM website link or technical documentation supporting the offered configuration. 6. Delivery, Installation and Commissioning 1. Delivery shall be made to the consignee location specified in the GeM contract. 2. The delivery period shall be as specified in the GeM bid and contract. 3. The supplier shall ensure safe transportation and delivery of the scanner with all standard accessori es. 4. The supplier shall install and configure the scanner, drivers and supplied software wherever require d. 5. The supplier shall demonstrate simplex and duplex scanning, OCR, searchable PDF generation and network connectivity. 6. The supplier shall ensure that the scanner is fully functional and ready for use. 7. All applicable packing, forwarding, transportation, installation and commissioning costs shall be incl uded in the quoted price. 7. Inspection and Acceptance 1. The consignee or authorized inspection committee shall inspect the supplied scanner. 2. The scanner shall be checked for physical condition, OEM identity, accessories and technical compli ance. 3. The buyer may conduct a functional test to verify: Simplex and duplex scanning speed. ADF capacity and paper feeding. Double-feed detection. OCR and searchable PDF generation. USB, Ethernet and Wi-Fi connectivity. Compatibility with the supplied software and operating system. 4. Any scanner found damaged, defective, incomplete or technically non-compliant shall be replaced b y the supplier at no additional cost. 5. Acceptance shall be recorded after satisfactory inspection, installation and demonstration. 8. Warranty and After-Sales Support 1. The supplier shall provide a minimum 3-year comprehensive onsite warranty from the date of succe ssful installation/acceptance, as applicable under the GeM contract. 2. Warranty shall cover the scanner, ADF mechanism, scanning components, power adapter and other supplied hardware components. 3. The warranty shall include repair or replacement of defective parts without additional cost. 4. The supplier shall ensure access to OEM-authorized service support throughout the warranty period . 5. The supplier shall provide warranty registration details and service contact information at the time of delivery. 9. Payment Terms Payment shall be made in accordance with the GeM contract and applicable Government financial rules, s ubject to satisfactory delivery, installation, commissioning and acceptance of the equipment. 10. Liquidated Damages Liquidated damages and other consequences of delay or non-performance shall be governed by the applic able GeM General Terms and Conditions and the terms incorporated in the bid/contract. 11. Right of Acceptance and Rejection 1. The buyer reserves the right to verify the technical specifications and supporting documents submit ted by the bidder. 2. Offers not meeting the prescribed minimum technical requirements may be rejected.
